name: Conspiracies
overview: Scripture reveals that conspiracies are deliberate, secretive plans formed against God's people, as seen when enemies took counsel to oppose Jerusalem's restoration and plotted harm against the faithful (Nehemiah 4:7; Psalms 83:3; Jeremiah 11:9,19). The Bible warns believers not to fear such alliances or be swayed by their intimidation (Isaiah 8:12), and it reminds us that those who devise evil schemes ultimately bring judgment upon themselves (Proverbs 26:27). These passages encourage trust in God's sovereignty amid opposition and deception.
